messages:
alex_sales: Hey team — FinRegCo wants an EU-only POC next week. Requirements: BYO-KMS (customer-managed keys in EU), no US sub-processors touching plaintext, and routing pinned to EU region. Need confirmation on: which subprocessors are used in EU-only mode, what happens if EU capacity is exhausted (fallback behavior), and any pricing delta for EU-pinned reserved capacity. Also will need attestation for subproc list. Can SRE/Eng/Sec advise? Thanks.

maria_sre: Short answer: we can pin tenant + enforce eu-only routing. Need to confirm model availability; some larger models are only in our central (US) pool. Two options: 1) pin and reject requests if no EU replica (fail-open=false) or 2) allow fallback to US-compatible model (fail-open=true). Which does customer prefer?

tom_engineer: We can set config like:
```json
{"tenant_id":"finregco-poc","region_preference":"eu-only","fallback_policy":"reject","byok":"kms-eu:customer-key-id"}
```
Note: fallback_policy=reject returns 503 if model not available. Also recommend pinning model version to a known eu-replica hash.

zoe_security: I need exact subprocessor list and dataflows. In EU-only mode dataplane, logging, and metrics are kept in EU: aws eu-west-1, gcp europe-west4, datadog-eu. We do not route plaintext to US unless fallback_policy=allow. BYO-KMS: we support wrapping keys with customer KMS via dedicated key proxy. Need customer consent + SOC2 addendum. We'll require a subproc attestation doc — can draft.

alex_sales: Customer says they will accept reject-on-miss for POC. They need the subproc attestation and estimated cost delta by EOD tomorrow. Also wants a test tenant and a simple cURL they can run.

maria_sre: Cost delta: EU-reserved pinned pool + 99% eu-only SLO adds ~12% on top of standard committed capacity; BYO-KMS bring operational fee ~ $1,500 setup + $300/mo key proxy. Egress and cross-region transfers billed per GB as usual. I'll do a formal quote.

tom_engineer: I'll provision a test tenant and share cURL. For quick smoke test use:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"finregco-poc","input":"hello"}' https://eu-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
I'll create a model pin: model: rl-large-v2@sha256:abcd... (eu replica).

ops_bot: Support ticket created: #SUP-4821 (POC finregco eu-only, BYO-KMS). Owner: tom_engineer. ETA: provisioned test tenant in 18h.

zoe_security: I'll draft the subprocessor attestation and the dataflow diagram. Can someone drop an exported routing policy and the list of third-party endpoints we call in EU mode?

maria_sre: Attaching quick list:
- compute: aws eu-west-1, gcp europe-west4
- storage: s3 eu-west-1 (encrypted), gcs eu-west4
- metrics: datadog-eu
- model artifacts: internal artifact-store-eu
- telemetry: telemetry-eu.redwood.com
I'll put formal doc in the ticket.

alex_sales: Great — I'll update customer. If we can get attestation + quote by EOD tomorrow we're good. Thanks all :rocket:
